why_it_matters: A session reported 'everything is uncommitted in the shared tree, since I can't witness my own build and landing belongs to the standing loop' as a terminal, which hands the owner work the session could finish. The gap was real: the declared loop had no witness step, so a builder that finished verify found no step telling it custody continued. Agents now hold custody and charge over their work to the landed result by contract, not by exhortation, and the failure mode is a named refusal with a fixture proving it fires.
